description: Compare latest Grand Exchange prices for up to 10 items in one call. Provide either names or itemIds. Returns one row per entry with id, name, price, volume and timestamp; entries that cannot be resolved come back as error rows instead of failing the call.

itemIds.description: Grand Exchange item IDs to compare (1-10). Provide names or itemIds, not both.

names.description: Item names to compare (1-10). Provide names or itemIds, not both.

name: compare_items
title: Compare Items
